text:
#!name=美图秀秀
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0346 / 美图秀秀 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0385 / 美图秀秀去广告 / 可莉🅥[https://github.com/luestr/ProxyResource/blob/main/README.md]

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, corp.meitu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, gg.meitu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, message.meitu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, tuiguang.meitu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, xiuxiu.android.dl.meitu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, adui.tg.meitu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, rabbit.tg.meitu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, meitubeauty.meitudata.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, xiuxiu.mobile.meitudata.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, dc.meitustat.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, mdc.meitustat.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, rabbit.meitustat.com,REJECT
DOMAIN,adui.tg.meitu.com,REJECT,extended-matching,pre-matching

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mea\.meitudata\.com\/kaiping/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/adui\.tg\.meitu\.com/i then reject_dict(200)

[Body Rewrite]
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.posters\.meitu\.com\/common\/init\.json 'delpaths([["data","vip"]])'

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% mea.meitudata.com, adui.tg.meitu.com, api.posters.meitu.com
